records.tested_change: Replace an aligned-input cosine proxy with 1-bit grouped-key mean-logit ranking of visual token chunks, at fixed per-layer resident precision counts. Relative L2 attention-output errors: one-bit 0.02518 vs exact softmax mass 0.01510 on candy; 0.02229 vs 0.01510 on statue. One-bit failed the frozen fidelity gate.
records.scope: Two already-exposed SmolVLM-256M still images; 30 layers and decoder steps 1–3. Eight chunks of eight visual tokens with fixed counts: two FP16, three INT4, three INT2; first chunk FP16. Generic affine KV quantization.
limitations: Not a WindowQuant or FIER replication; aligned-input embeddings and token chunks are proxies.
Not held-out data, video clips, end-to-end generation or propagated error evaluation.
Scoring uses 32-token key groups; resident KV uses 8-token groups. These are distinct surrogate operators.
No measured GPU memory traffic, speed or transient overhead; an efficiency-versus-fidelity tradeoff remains untested.
No scientific novelty or general infeasibility claim. The whole source pair is not rejected.
